name: Nét
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Net, also written Neit, is an obscure Irish god. He is remembered solely as the partner of the war goddess Nemain. From that tie he is seen as a war god. He might equal Nemed, who was married to Macha. The accounts clash: some name him a Fomorian, and others count him among the Tuatha De Danann.
